name: Senn Rill
seed: To keep Crownrest open to friends without selling its private paths.
design: Rust-red squirrel, long tail, cream neck, leaf-green split coat, amber resin clasp.
history: A crown bridgewright raised between a moving village and the fixed ridge school. His mother helped conceal a refuge route when toll collectors threatened it.
desire: To keep Crownrest open to friends without selling its private paths.
contradiction: Treats every outsider’s question as a possible theft.
relationships: Neri knows his aunt; Nix used a true story from his community; Lark values his corrections.
arc: Shares a limited route with accountable partners and stops confusing secrecy with protection.
story_engine: A root bridge must be cut to save the crown; a festival guest knows a song no outsider should know.
writer_truth: The concealed shelter contains ordinary families, not a weapon or chosen heir.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
